item.description:
About My Games

Ever since I made my first game at the beginning of 2022 in CMU’s Game Creation Society club, I’ve been totally hooked! Game dev combines many of my favorite things:

  • Problem Solving
  • Programming
  • Creativity
  • Humor
  • Video Games

After college, I intend to continue making games as a hobby and possibly as a side hustle. My game engine of choice is Godot.

item.title: Welcome to the Domonation!
item.description:
Hello passerby,

I’m Dominick Robinson, a senior at Carnegie Mellon University studying Mathematics (concentration in Statistics) with a Creative Writing minor. I am currently interested in pursuing data science, software engineering, or something in the middle.

Outside of academics and work, I love playing tennis, pickleball, and all other racket sports. I have a YouTube channel that nowadays mainly serves to preserve things I like to do. I also love developing games, which you’ll find on this site.

item.title: Writings
item.description:
About My Writings

I’m pursuing a Creative Writing minor, which has led to some of my most personal and humorous works.

CMU Pickleball’s Successful Summer

September 2023
CMU Pickleball had a sizzling summer in 2023 as they earned 5 medals in various events, so I just had to create another article for The Tartan to commemorate it.

CMU Pickleball Plays Inaugural Game at RMU

May 2023
I wrote this article for the school newspaper The Tartan to commemorate CMU Pickleball’s first-ever match against another school. While we got smoked, it was still a lot of fun. This article also granted me the position of “Junior Staffwriter.”
